Source: ServUO scripts: SBInfo shops (numbers only). Sells = vendor sells to players (GenericBuyInfo), Buys = vendor buys from players (GenericSellInfo). Core.* era checks taken as true, Siege as false.

Notes.Economy: ServUO's vendor economy (BaseVendor.UseVendorEconomy = Core.AOS && !Siege) treats Stackable entries as economy items: the vendor always restocks 500 of them, and the price moves +1 per 1000 bought by players and -1 per 1000 sold to the vendor (never below 2); when a vendor also sells a Stackable type, it buys it back for max(1, int(current sell price * 0.75)) instead of the Buys price.
Notes.PriceScalar: Sells prices are multiplied by the vendor's price scalar: 100 + the faction town tax when the vendor stands in a faction town, else 100 (price*scalar+50)/100.
Notes.BuysAdjustments: Buys prices are the base: armour and weapons pay 60%% for low quality, 125%% for exceptional, +100 per durability and per protection/damage level; Pitcher pays 3 empty or milk / 5 full, BeverageBottle 3, Jug 6 regardless of the table.
Notes.Resale: Items a player sells to a vendor are resold at 1.9 x the Buys price.
Notes.Restock: Stock is the amount on hand after a restock (Utility.Random ranges are drawn per restock).
Notes.Hue: Hue rules: Utility.Random<Rule>Hue() drawn when the vendor builds its list.

SBCarpentryBuyback.Derived: Computed by ServUO at startup from the carpentry craft list (DefCarpentry): every craftable item whose materials are all basic (Board 3, Log 2, Cloth 2, IronIngot 6, Feather 1, BlankScroll 5, Nails 3, or carpentry-made parts of those) and that has a parameterless constructor; sells for materials*2 + skill*2 + 10, buys for max(1, materials + skill) capped at half of any other shop's price for it; MinSkill truncated; at most the 250 cheapest.
